title: Creación del esquema (tablespace, usuario taller y permisos) conectado como sys en xepdb1

parts.code:
CREATE TABLESPACE taller_tblspc
DATAFILE '/opt/oracle/oradata/XE/XEPDB1/taller_tblspc01.dbf'
SIZE 50M
AUTOEXTEND ON
NEXT 10M
MAXSIZE UNLIMITED
SEGMENT SPACE MANAGEMENT AUTO;

CREATE USER taller IDENTIFIED BY taller_pwd
DEFAULT TABLESPACE taller_tblspc
TEMPORARY TABLESPACE temp
QUOTA UNLIMITED ON taller_tblspc;

GRANT CREATE SESSION, CREATE TABLE, CREATE VIEW, CREATE SEQUENCE, CREATE PROCEDURE, CREATE TRIGGER TO taller;
parts.label: sys@xepdb1

title: Carga del script del instructor: filas por tabla (EMPLOYEES debe tener 107)

parts.code:
SELECT 'EMPLOYEES' AS tabla, COUNT(*) AS filas FROM employees
UNION ALL SELECT 'DEPARTMENTS', COUNT(*) FROM departments
UNION ALL SELECT 'LOCATIONS', COUNT(*) FROM locations
UNION ALL SELECT 'COUNTRIES', COUNT(*) FROM countries
UNION ALL SELECT 'REGIONS', COUNT(*) FROM regions
UNION ALL SELECT 'JOBS', COUNT(*) FROM jobs
UNION ALL SELECT 'JOB_HISTORY', COUNT(*) FROM job_history;

title: a) Direcciones de las ubicaciones con el nombre de su país
b) Apellido, departamento y nombre de departamento de todos los empleados (LEFT JOIN)
c) Empleados que trabajan en Toronto

parts.code:
SELECT e.last_name, j.job_title, e.department_id, d.department_name
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id
JOIN locations l ON d.location_id = l.location_id
JOIN jobs j ON e.job_id = j.job_id
WHERE l.city = 'Toronto';

title: e) Empleados y sus gerentes, incluido quien no tiene gerente (LEFT JOIN)

parts.code:
SELECT e.last_name AS "Employee", e.employee_id AS "Emp#", m.last_name AS "Manager", m.employee_id AS "Mgr#"
FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN employees m ON e.manager_id = m.employee_id
ORDER BY e.employee_id;

title: f) Compañeros de departamento de cada empleado

parts.code:
SELECT e.department_id AS "Departamento", e.last_name AS "Empleado", c.last_name AS "Colega"
FROM employees e
JOIN employees c ON e.department_id = c.department_id AND e.employee_id <> c.employee_id
ORDER BY e.department_id, e.last_name, c.last_name;

title: g) Estructura de JOB_GRADES y grado salarial de cada empleado

parts.code:
SELECT e.last_name, j.job_title, d.department_name, e.salary, g.grade_level
FROM employees e
JOIN jobs j ON e.job_id = j.job_id
LEFT JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id
JOIN job_grades g ON e.salary BETWEEN g.lowest_sal AND g.highest_sal;

title: h) Empleados contratados después de Davies
i) Empleados contratados antes que su supervisor

parts.code:
SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS "Empleado", e.hire_date AS "Contratacion Empleado",
       m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS "Supervisor", m.hire_date AS "Contratacion Supervisor"
FROM employees e
JOIN employees m ON e.manager_id = m.employee_id
WHERE e.hire_date < m.hire_date;

title: j) Empleados del mismo departamento que un empleado dado (DEFINE apellido = Davies)

parts.code:
DEFINE apellido = Davies
SELECT last_name, hire_date
FROM employees
WHERE department_id IN (SELECT department_id FROM employees WHERE last_name = '&&apellido')
AND last_name <> '&&apellido';
UNDEFINE apellido

title: k) Empleados con salario superior al promedio

parts.code:
SELECT employee_id, last_name
FROM employees
WHERE salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees)
ORDER BY salary ASC;

title: l) Empleados en departamentos con algún empleado cuyo apellido contiene la letra u
m) Empleados de departamentos ubicados en location_id 1700
n) Empleados cuyo gerente es King

parts.code:
SELECT e.department_id, e.last_name, e.job_id
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id
